cards.front: Algorithm 5.1: Bubble Sort, steps in order.

Step 3: SET j = 0
Step 4: WHILE j< n-i-1,REPEAT STEPS 5 to 7

Step 7: SET j=j+1
Step 8: SET i=i+1
